title: 💰 Statistical Base Year Overhauls — CPI 2024 Base (Food Weight Cut to 36.75%) & IIP/GDP 2022-23 Base
summary: MoSPI revised CPI basket structure for 2024 base: food & beverage weight reduced to 36.75% (from 45.86%), housing increased to 17.66% (from 10.07%), and total items expanded to 358 (from 299).

blocks.content: Pay close attention to statutory outlays, regulatory deadlines, and institutional authority under National Statistical Framework Overhaul. Durable MoSPI base year revisions for CPI (2024=100, food weight cut from 45.86% to 36.75%), GDP (2022-23), and IIP (2022-23).
